name: Omnigraph
description: Stores agent memory in a typed, branchable graph database with graph, vector and full-text search in one query, served over CLI, HTTP and built-in MCP.

skills.name: Typed Graph Schema
skills.description: Declares node and edge types, keys and constraints in .pg schemas and enforces them on every write agents make.

skills.name: Multimodal Retrieval
skills.description: Combines graph traversal, vector nearest-neighbour and full-text search with rank fusion in a single query for agent context.

skills.name: Branch and Merge
skills.description: Creates a branch per agent or task, then merges reviewed changes back with three-way merge and time travel across the graph.

skills.name: Built-in MCP Server
skills.description: Serves the graph's stored queries and mutations to MCP clients at the server's /mcp endpoint with bearer or OIDC auth.

skills.name: Cedar Access Policy
skills.description: Checks every mutation against Cedar policies per graph or server-wide, with actors resolved server-side and audit tracking.
